canonical_name: Bluegrass Jam with Finkelstein 3 (Oklawaha Brewing Company)
summary: A weekly pickup bluegrass/old-time jam hosted by a house trio called Finkelstein 3 at Oklawaha Brewing Company in Hendersonville, running 6:30-8:30pm every Wednesday. Listings and tags describe it as a drop-in, all-skill-levels pickup circle ('bring your fiddle, banjo, guitar, mandolin, or just your ears') rather than a booked act, and it is catalogued by the Blue Ridge Music Trails project, which tends to document traditional jam sessions with a real community of returning pickers. No independent evidence was found of a distinct group identity, member roster, or dedicated group page separate from the brewery's own event listing.

evidence.note: Listings describe an instrumental pickup jam ('bring your fiddle, banjo, guitar, mandolin, or just your ears') at a brewery taproom, tagged Pickup Jam, Drop In Jam, Sit Ins Welcome, All Skill Levels rather than a ticketed show.
The brewery's own site lists 'Bluegrass Jam with Finkelstein 3' as a recurring Wednesday house event, with no further detail on participation or membership.

The jam is catalogued by the Blue Ridge Music Trails project (page itself returned a bot-check and no readable content), a regional heritage effort that specifically documents traditional old-time/bluegrass jam sessions as ongoing community gatherings, which is suggestive but not confirmed evidence of a returning core of players.
No dedicated Facebook group, Meetup page, or 'about the jam' page for the jam itself was found; only the brewery's own venue page and generic listing/review sites turned up.
